items.x: The Florida A&M volleyball team swept Southern on Monday.

items.t: ‘We need to come together’: Florida A&M head football coach shares thoughts on Perry Street shooting
items.x: Before talking about this coming weekend’s match-up with Southern, he wasted no time in sending his condolences to everyone impacted by Saturday night’s shooting.

items.t: ‘He’s a good boy’: Leon High School JV football player injured in Perry Street shooting, head coach confirms
items.x: Leon High School Lions head football coach Ricky Bell confirmed to WCTV that one of his junior varsity players was injured.

items.t: Dot Inman-Johnson files defamation lawsuit against Tallahassee United PAC
items.x: Dot Inman Johnson has filed a lawsuit against political action committee Tallahassee United, which backs her opponent, Dianne Williams-Cox.

items.t: The Alexus House creates a safe haven for Tallahassee youth
items.x: A place of support for whatever young people in our community need, the Alexus House is a Tallahassee nonprofit providing a safe haven for area youth.

items.x: Time for something good - the power of parrotheads!

items.t: Bodycam video shows moments after parents say cops were called on 3-year-old for being ‘too good’ at soccer
items.x: A viral video claimed police were called because a 3-year-old was too good at soccer. Winter Park police released body camera video and described a dispute over playing time and the parents’ conduct.

items.t: Exclusive: Trump defends federal poll watchers, floats Guard deployment
items.x: Speaking with Atlanta News First backstage in Perry, Trump defended the U.S. Department of Justice’s plan to station federal monitors in six Democratic-majority Georgia counties on Election Day.

items.t: Boy dies 5 years after being hit by crossfire in quadruple shooting
items.x: A 13-year-old boy has died five years after he was shot in a quadruple shooting, according to police in Cincinnati, Ohio.

items.t: ‘Wasn’t a very pleasant experience’: FAMU students process aftermath Perry Street shooting
items.x: Florida A&M students returned to class for the first time since Saturday’s shooting just steps from campus.

items.t: Family says 7-year-old girl injured in Bend school shooting moved out of ICU
items.x: The 7-year-old girl who survived a shooting at a Bend elementary school earlier this month has been moved out of the intensive care unit.

items.t: Above average this week—Moisture increases by the weekend
items.x: Sunshine and warm temperatures will continue through midweek, but we are looking ahead to higher moisture levels for Halloween weekend. Chief Meteorologist Mike McCall has more.

items.t: ‘I get very angry’: Valdosta mother speaks out after son’s shooting as family seeks help
items.x: The mother of a 10-year-old boy shot in the face by a 9-year-old in September says she has not been told of a court date in the case, and that the mother of the boy involved still lives a few houses down from her.

items.t: United flight returned after passenger made terrorism threat, police say
items.x: A United Airlines flight headed to New Jersey returned to Las Vegas on Saturday night after the crew reported a passenger disturbance.

items.t: 13 students taken to hospital after Mississippi school bus collision
items.x: Multiple students were taken to a hospital after a Mississippi school bus was involved in a collision Monday morning, authorities said.

items.t: Georgia secretary of state downplaying Anthropic AI bot that accessed election data
